label: Pika Music (hosted, Comfy Router)
_note: Pika's music model through Comfy Router (pika/pika-music; its schema in tests/fixtures/router_schemas/pika__pika-music.json): a description, lyrics to sing, a length of 10 to 360 s and a seed. Paid per take. A cue's take is one Router call (cue.hosted_call), the audio its output's media. A draft: on 2026-11-04 Router listed it but answered a valid request 'Comfy Router does not run this model yet' (nothing run, nothing billed); switch it on (Enable) once Router serves it.

capabilities._note: Score or songs from a description (the arc told as a story, as Stable Audio 3) and lyrics; no bpm, key or section input.

template._note: The request's duration: whole seconds, 10 to 360.
